title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency: Recurring Ancillary Services Secured by an Additional Deposit
content:
**Ancillary billing liaison note — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** The recurring-service allowance of the additional deposit is read from the recurring charges (cable television, telephone, oxygen concentrator) posted to the resident's **Ancillary and Optional Services Billing** account. "Within the last three months" and "within the last twelve months" count entries whose date is fewer than that many whole calendar months before the day the deposit is worked out.

1. **Services that ran through the whole period.** Where recurring charges were posted within the last three months and every recurring service among them was also charged before those three months and in the latest service month billed, the allowance is the total of those charges divided by three.
2. **A service that did not.** Where recurring charges were posted within the last three months but a service among them did not run through the whole period, the allowance is the total of all the recurring charges billed for the latest service month — the service month of the recurring charge posted latest, the charge posted first deciding where two share that posting date. Every service charged for that month counts, not one entry alone.
3. **No recurring charge in three months.** The allowance is one month of every recurring service billed to the resident within the last twelve months, at the ancillary price schedule's monthly charge for that service.

**Hypothetical cases, at the published ancillary prices.** Cable television charged every month for more than a year at 42.00: the three charges in the window total 126.00, and the allowance under item 1 is 42.00. No recurring charge in the last three months, and an oxygen concentrator on an Ancillary Account, Private Pay last charged five months ago: one month at 185.00 under item 3.
